text: Whoa! Rollo! I can't stop! Can I hold the lens? Not NOW!
Miss Loupe is lost... at NIGHT! How do we find her... with no sun?
Oh my. My ball feels... lighter.
Big secrets of tiny bugs!
My garden map! We are here... at home. And Miss Loupe?
She flew off... straight that way.
Off my map?! I'll lead the way! I'll find her!
Team, count off! One, two, three, four, five! I'll be the light!
I'll keep the map. Come home safe!
Waggle wants to dance!
Bees dance to show the way... using the sun! Can you find the sun?
Nope!
No sun tonight, little bee. Then I'll use my antennae!
I'm lost... so I stay put. My friends will find me!
Ants follow smell trails! Sniff, sniff... this way!
My family! Hi, everyone! One, two, three, four, five, six ants!
Follow the trail... under the leaf...
over the pebble!
The trail ends here! The edge of the garden.
No trail? Let me think... My cousins in the desert...
keep track of their steps!
Out... and straight back home!
I count steps too!
One, two, three, four, five... six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
Ten steps from the trail! So we can find our way back!
I see close things... not far things! I wish cousin Telly were here!
Which way is straight? It all looks the same! Leave that to me.
I look up... at the Milky Way.
Wow... a river of stars! It keeps me rolling straight.
So straight!
Oh! Clouds!
Oh my. No stars... no straight! Rollo is rolling in wiggles!
Stars are back. Straight on!
Telly! Over here!
Look! A flash! Far away! One, two, three flashes! Uncle Telly! He sees far!
Blink! Flash your secret code! Blink! Blink! Blink!
She's over there! Let's go!
Look closely... look closely...
A sparkle! Miss Loupe! Crumb! You found me! Hold on! We'll pull you out!
Is it a monster? Nope! It's the Giant. A gentle friend.
Hello, Giant! Thank you!
Thank you, friend!
Crumb, you looked closely... all by yourself! Can I hold the lens... NOW?
Yes! NOW!
Ants follow...?
Smell trails! Rollo follows...?
The stars! And bees dance with...?
The sun! You're home! All of you!
Look! My whole garden is glowing!
And a brand new corner!
Six legs, six legs, count them with me!
Head, thorax, abdomen... one, two, three!
Two little antennae, sniff and see... That's a bug! That's a bug!
BZZT! Not you, Spindle!
Look closely... and you'll always find your way! Wait! Did you spot Spindle?
Crumb! Come back! Not NOW! Yippee!
Rollo! That's the END of the page!
Oh my. It's a pond! So... what does Rollo follow?
The stars!
